_about: The order of the final page. scripts/build_all.py reads this and writes one self-contained file. 'story' runs are scenes from final/story/template.html (SCENES), by id, or '*' for all of them; 'module' entries are prototype sections, placed between them; 'plugin' entries bring in a prototype's layers for the story's shared globe without placing a section. Edit the order here, never in the built file.
_note: Option A (5 Oct): one shared globe. The rain gauges come in as a plugin: their layers (slide 5's map, the gap cells) and the explorer's panel, which the story mounts under slide 8's words. Slides 2-4 (history), 10-15 (Idai), 17 (country profile) and 18 (stories) are story slides until those prototypes are built in the same way.
